name: 5dive-phone
description: The 5dive phone plugin, published from its own repository. One plugin, one repo — the shape `5dive plugin add <owner>/<repo>` was built for.

plugins.name: phone
plugins.description: Your agent uses apps on a spare Android phone you set aside for it (TikTok, Instagram, your own app's test build): it reads the screen, taps and types in any language over your Tailscale network, with only Tailscale installed on the phone. Sending, posting, deleting and paying follow the browser's rules: paying asks you first; careful makes all four ask.
